summary.motive: Generate organic 4-man pass rush via Wide-9 speed angles while suffocating passing concepts with pattern-matching Cover 3 Rip/Liz rules.
summary.keyDefender: WDE (Wide-9 speed rusher) & SAM (Apex match defender on slot seam)
summary.whyItWorks: Wide-9 ends force offensive tackles onto an island without chip help, while the match rules turn zone coverage into tight man coverage on all vertical routes.
summary.failureMode: Quick four-vertical flood concepts that stretch the single-high FS, or power gap runs attacking the widened defensive line B-gaps.

beats.title: Wide-9 Stance & Single-High Shell
beats.text: Robert Saleh aligns both defensive ends (WDE & SDE) in extreme Wide-9 alignments outside offensive tackles to create unmatched speed-rush angles, while safety shell rolls into single-high Rip/Liz match.

beats.title: Pattern Match Triggers & Edge Surge
beats.text: As the ball is snapped, SAM matches slot H vertically, SS buzzes down to jump the TE out route, and WDE bends past the LT on an unstoppable 9-technique arc.

beats.title: Windows Bracketed & Pocket Clamped
beats.text: MIKE walls off the crossing dig from Z, FS caps the slot seam, and WDE hits full speed bending around the edge, giving the QB nowhere to deliver the football.

beats.title: 4-Man Pressure Finishes
beats.text: Without committing an extra blitzer, the 4-man Wide-9 front generates instant pressure while all 7 coverage defenders clamp their pattern-matched receivers.

relations.tell: Base single-high alignment with SS rolling into the 8-man box/overhang at snap
